scope: Fresh archive staging source and focused hosted check preparation only
checks: Read both complete copy/supervisor helpers, complete focused check and downloader, all inputs, README and actual workflow. Independently verified the five input-bound file hashes and byte-identical workflow copy.

Compared the complete supervisor with the accepted materializer controller. Path validation, Windows argument quoting, retained Job/PID/birth identity and owned stopping functions are byte-identical after the inspector class rename; the embedded controller declaration is likewise identical. The changed command/request/result contract retains 180 seconds total, a cleanup reserve, BelowNormal priority and 512 MiB aggregate owned RSS, and adds the 1 GiB live free-memory sampling.

The copy helper reads local archives with write/delete sharing excluded, verifies exact outer hashes/sizes, uses ordinary .NET ZIP streams, rejects unsafe/case-colliding/unexpected/nonregular entries, and verifies every nested runtime/native payload before creating a fresh stage. Its bounded 64 KiB stream checks verify exact sizes/hashes; the accepted inner ZIP is a measured 7,137,798-byte memory buffer.

Matched every fixed app archive/manifest/source/result identity to the independently recovered original records. Recomputed the 560-file manifest count and 27,426,391-byte total. Runtime count, source/build identity, lockfile, unique BUILD_ID and the unchanged installer input contract are checked again after copying.

The final native request remains deliberately unbound. Its eventual exact release/package/manifest/metadata/build receipt must all agree on source, target, tree, workflow, run, size and digest. The helper executes neither executable and modifies no original repository.

Fresh immediate-child stage and exclusive claim semantics preserve successful or interrupted evidence and reject replay. Failure results retain partial files. The supervisor treats assisted cleanup, time/RSS exhaustion or remaining owned children as failure.

The hosted downloader obtains only the pinned existing 7,056,005-byte app Actions ZIP. It verifies metadata/run/digest/expiry and downloaded bytes, uses no authorization header for the redirected download, bounds network time and size, and retains no temporary download URL or credential.

The hosted check extracts exact reviewed function ASTs without invoking PC entry points. It parses three PowerShell files, compiles one unchanged declaration without invoking methods, copies the actual complete 560-file runtime using a synthetic native package, and retains all actual file hashes. The remaining fixtures test stream-sized and empty content, exact installer outputs, identity/hash/size/count/BUILD_ID/provenance refusal, eight unsafe path forms, seven malformed ZIP cases, reparse ancestors, expiry and intact interrupted-copy evidence/replay refusal.

Independently counted all 40 declared checks and read every assertion. The exact actual-runtime inventory uses complete chunked retention; the entire result is emitted as original base64 JSON. All check filesystem work is within a fresh hosted temporary fixture, with an external canary verified unchanged.

The workflow has only hosted Windows checkout, download, focused checks and retained output; no package installation, product build or product start. Its exact candidate, pinned actions, read-only permissions, isolated activation branch and 8-minute hosted job bound are preserved.
